reasoning: On the season so far the Nuggets are the stronger team; with home court the Nuggets start about 12 points better, in a game of about 240 points.
Rest, travel and who is missing tilt it about 2 points towards the Nuggets.
There are psychological storylines, but history says they are worth little here.
Bottom line: the Nuggets win 88 times in 100, by about 14; most games like this end between 214 and 262 total points.

analyst.text: New Orleans play the second night of a back-to-back amid a spiral that led Zion Williamson to call their recent blowouts "unacceptable" and demand accountability. Trey Murphy III has been sidelined by knee soreness. Denver are coming off a 123-118 win in Memphis, with Jamal Murray scoring 30 and Nikola Jokic adding 27, 11 and 8. They also won the earlier meeting by 13. Unless the Pelicans channel Zion's challenge, the mood and freshness lean strongly toward Denver.
